_readme: Shared infrastructure groups. Each group is a binary decision per plot (infra[p,g]); its fixed cost is charged ONCE no matter how many production systems on that plot require it. This is the explicit mechanism behind CapEx(shared) < sum of standalone CapEx. No Qatar-specific published figures were located for these items, so they are required inputs.
